units.source_text: 于是，我也决定推迟出发，到楼下去。

en.t: So I too decided to put off my departure and went downstairs.

units.source_text: 我等候他们起床，一边在肮脏的账房里同客店的人闲聊起来。

en.t: While waiting for them to get up, I began chatting with the inn people in the filthy office.
The man invited me to go for a walk.

units.source_text: 从马路稍往南走，有一座很漂亮的桥。

en.t: A short way south from the road, there was a very beautiful bridge.

units.source_text: 我们靠在桥栏杆上，他又谈起自己的身世。

en.t: We leaned against the bridge railing, and he began talking again about his life story.

units.source_text: 他说，他本人曾一度参加东京新派剧剧团。

en.t: He said that he himself had once belonged to a Tokyo shinpa theater troupe.

units.source_text: 据说，这剧种至今仍经常在大岛港演出。

en.t: It was said that this kind of drama was still often performed at Oshima Harbor.

units.source_text: 刀鞘像一条腿，从他们的行李包袱里露出来。

en.t: A sword scabbard stuck out from their bundles like a leg.

units.source_text: 有时，也在宴席上表演仿新派剧，让客人观赏。

en.t: At times, they also performed shinpa-style plays at banquets for the guests to watch.

units.source_text: 柳条包里装有戏装和锅碗瓢勺之类的生活用具。

en.t: The wicker baskets held costumes and household utensils such as pots, bowls, ladles, and spoons.
